title: Low Water
summary: The drowned of the old imperial harbour have been walking up Tollhaven's quays at night. The quays' chaplain, a Grey Sister, took a boat out to the Drowned Mole after them. Hester Quaile wants both seen to.

steps.journal: Take the beach road to Gullwick and the ferry out to the Drowned Mole. The Harbourmaster keeps the outer mole's end, on the dungeon's second floor.

ready: The Harbourmaster is down and the drowned on the mole lie still. Go back to Hester Quaile at the Paid Toll in Tollhaven.
done: Tollhaven's quays are quiet at night. Somebody sang the drowned up from the mole's lamp-stand, and Hester wants a name.
